wages.text: Barragán says she will keep pushing a pro-labor agenda that includes raising the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour and protecting union wage standards.
wages.quote: I will continue to advocate for a pro-labor agenda, including raising the minimum wage to $15.00 per hour and ensuring Davis-Bacon Act protections remain in place.

health.text: Barragán calls health care a fundamental right and has consistently defended and sought to strengthen the Affordable Care Act.
health.quote: Healthcare is a fundamental right. Throughout my time in Congress, I have consistently fought on behalf of the Affordable Care Act.

energy.text: Barragán voted for the Inflation Reduction Act's climate investments and celebrated federal action to cut pollution and address the climate crisis.
energy.quote: we will finally give you the resources to fight pollution and climate change locally, on your terms.

tax.text: Angel favors tax cuts, arguing lower rates spur growth and raise federal revenue.
tax.quote: Tax cuts encourage economic expansion which would result in increases in federal government revenue at a lower tax rate.

debt.text: She strongly supported cutting government spending to reduce the national debt.
debt.quote: The government should cut spending in order to reduce the national debt.

immigration.text: Angel opposes sanctuary cities and wants those in the country illegally deported rather than released.
immigration.quote: These sanctuary cities allow criminal illegal immigrants to be released into the community rather than being deported, thereby endangering residents.

guns.text: Angel says she supports the Second Amendment and the right to own firearms for self defense, hunting and sport.
guns.quote: I support the Second Ammendment because I believe in my right and everyone's right to own firearms for self defense, hunting, and sport.

abortion.text: She said abortion should generally be prohibited, with exceptions for threats to the mother’s life, rape, and incest, and opposed public funding for abortion providers.
abortion.quote: The fetus is a human being and the Consitution protects its life. Abortion should be allowed when the mother's life is endagered by her pregnancy, and on exceptions for rape and incest.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Angel says attempts to socially or physically transition a child constitute child abuse.
gender.quote: Attempts to physically or socially transition a child to the opposite sex constitute child abuse.

health.text: She supported keeping Medicaid and Medicare available while opposing additional taxpayer-funded health programs.
health.quote: C - Federal government should prioritize protecting vulnerable populations specifically the seniors, the disabled, and low-income families—while reducing spending on other social services; while the State level can better manage programs such as childcare and social services.

energy.text: She identifies coal and nuclear power as reliable sources for meeting rising electricity demand and supports reducing regulations affecting fossil-fuel refineries.
energy.quote: The use of coal and nuclear energy are both the most reliable, baseload energy sources to meet growing electricity demand, particularly for AI data centers and manufacturing.

voting.text: Angel supports tighter voter ID and proof-of-citizenship requirements for state and federal elections.
voting.quote: I support all measures aimed at tightening national voter ID requirements and proof of citizenship for state and federal elections because it is essential for election integrity.
